verdict.rationale: Spline offers a 'Self-Hosted' export that lets you download a single project's assets and runtime as a ZIP (spline-docs-8/18/23), but this is per-project asset export, not self-hosting the editor/design platform itself, and there is no mention of an open-source license or ability to run the full Spline platform on one's own infrastructure. Community evidence confirms Spline is a cloud/Electron-wrapped web app requiring the hosted service (spline-comm-1).
